defects.description: The cron step names scripts/rotate-logs.sh, but the workspace ships the rotation script as scripts/rotate.sh.

defects.quote: serves its HTTP API on port 8080
defects.description: The stated API port 8080 contradicts server.port 8420 in config/ledgerd.yaml.
The health check URL uses port 8080, but config/ledgerd.yaml sets server.port to 8420, so the check fails.
Misspelling of 'previous' in the rollback section.

defects.quote: Rotated logs are kept for 30 days
defects.description: The 30-day retention contradicts docs/operations.md (14 days) and the --keep-days default of 14 in scripts/rotate.sh.

defects.quote: - Confirm the previous deploy finished and no drain is in progress.
defects.description: The 'Before any change' checklist repeats the 'Before you start' checklist in docs/deploy.md word for word.
Misspelling of 'receive'.

defects.quote: flushes the commit buffer to its shards
defects.description: 'commit buffer' names the component the rest of the docs call the write queue.

defects.quote: wait for the the queue to empty
defects.description: Doubled word 'the the'.
Informal 'nuclear option' wording in operator instructions.
The documented flush_interval default of 500ms contradicts queue.flush_interval 250ms in config/ledgerd.yaml; correcting it changes a stated fact, so it fails the high-confidence test.

defects.quote: Entries wait in the write queue until one of these limits is reached.
defects.description: The queue section omits queue.persist (false in config/ledgerd.yaml), so a reader is not told that unflushed entries are lost on restart; only a judgment read raises it. A finding anchored anywhere in the queue section (lines 28 to 36) about the missing persist setting matches this defect.
The same-file anchor #loging does not match the 'logging' heading; the one correct target is #logging.
The updated: header (2026-03-02) is older than the file's last commit, dated 2026-06-15.

defects.quote: As of March 2026, the current release is ledgerd 2.2.
defects.description: The dated version claim names release 2.2, but src/client.go ships Version 2.4.1 alongside the matching ledgerd release.
The stated retry count of 3 contradicts MaxRetries = 5 in src/client.go.
The cross-file anchor #draining-a-node no longer exists; docs/operations.md renamed the heading to 'Drain a node' (#drain-a-node).
The body link's host is under .invalid and can never resolve.
The link under References points at a .invalid host and can never resolve.

defects.quote: appends one entry and returns `200 OK`
defects.description: specs/api.md (Endpoints) gives 201 Created as the success status of POST /v2/entries, not 200 OK.
specs/api.md (Endpoints) caps limit at 500, not 1000.
The claim marked verified is false: config/ledgerd.yaml sets queue.persist to false, so queued entries are lost on restart.
The health check repeats docs/deploy.md's wrong port 8080; config/ledgerd.yaml sets server.port to 8420.
Misspelling of 'account'.
The anchor #entries does not match the 'Entry' heading (#entry).
Doubled word 'to to'.
Misspelling of 'which'.
Doubled word 'are are'.
The definition names the X-Request-ID header, but src/client.go and specs/api.md send the key in the Idempotency-Key header.

defects.quote: To roll out a new build
defects.description: The 'Rollout' entry is a paragraph of deployment steps that belongs in docs/deploy.md, not a definition.
Curly double quotes (U+201C, U+201D) in prose, in a repository whose CLAUDE.md adopts ASCII punctuation only.
An en dash (U+2013) in a week range, where CLAUDE.md requires a plain hyphen.
An ellipsis character (U+2026), where CLAUDE.md requires three periods.
The guide draws on an external page but has no References section, which CLAUDE.md requires for such a document.
A personal home-directory path (written in at setup) in a committed note, in a repository that ships scripts/scrub-check.sh for exactly this.
Conflicts with the Workflow line "Always run the full test suite before a commit" in the same file; an agent cannot follow both.

defects.quote: Format files properly before you push.
defects.description: Ambiguous directive: it names no formatter or command, so an agent cannot tell what properly means.

defects.quote: installing notectl on a fresh host
defects.description: The page states it walks a new operator through installing notectl on a fresh host, but most of it covers cloning, building, running, testing, and cleaning a source checkout for development; only the last section installs, and it installs from the release archive, so none of the source sections are needed. Any fit finding about the page's purpose matches this defect, wherever it anchors.

Titled as an install page, but most of it covers cloning, building, running, testing, and cleaning a source checkout for development; only the last section installs, and it installs from the release archive, so none of the source sections are needed. Any fit finding about the page's purpose matches this defect, wherever it anchors.
The notes say archives are kept 30 days, but backup.sh sets KEEP_DAYS=14 and deletes archives older than 14 days.
Q2 hosting is stated as 1,200 per month citing budget.csv, but budget.csv lists hosting,Q2,2100.
Repeated word "the the".
The retro says the queue migration shipped, but standup.md says it is blocked on the vendor and tasks.txt lists it as open and blocked.

defects.quote: Accepted raw samples remain queryable for 30 days
defects.description: ingest.md says raw samples stay queryable for 30 days, contradicting retention.md and index.md (15 days, raw_retention_days) and the raw_retention_days reference page (default 15).

defects.quote: If the on-call engineer has not acknowledged a page within 15 minutes
defects.description: The escalation paragraph in access.md repeats alerting.md's Escalation section word for word (alerting.md line 25), so the two copies can drift apart.

defects.quote: ## Granting read access to a new team
defects.description: The section on granting Viewer and service accounts to a new team is access policy and belongs in access.md, not in the ingest page.

defects.quote: The scheduler listens on port 8080 by default.
defects.description: The default port is 9170 per config/ferry.toml [server] port and the FERRY_PORT fallback in scripts/ferryctl.sh, not 8080.

defects.quote: retries a failed run up to 5 times
defects.description: With max_retries unset the scheduler uses DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES = 3 from src/scheduler.py, not 5.

defects.quote: Add `--wait` to make the command block until the run finishes
defects.description: scripts/ferryctl.sh submit accepts only --queue and --dry-run; --wait falls through to usage and exits 2.
The Operations log path contradicts the Configuration section and config/ferry.toml log_dir, which both give /var/log/ferry.
The configuration file is config/ferry.toml; config/ferry.yaml does not exist in the repository.
Misspelling of 'occurred' in the Troubleshooting introduction.

traps.quote: We deploy on Tuesdays and Thursdays — never on a Friday
traps.description: A legitimate em dash in prose; this repository's CLAUDE.md adopts no ASCII typography rule, so it is not a defect.
GitHub keeps underscores in heading anchors, so #tuning-max_batch correctly targets the 'Tuning max_batch' heading.
The second 'Checks' heading gets the GitHub anchor #checks-1, so the link is correct.

traps.quote: func Map[T any](xs []T, f func(T) T) []T {
traps.description: Go generic type parameters inside a go fence, not a Markdown link; the helper exists in src/client.go.

traps.quote: Fields marked [optional] in the API specification
traps.description: Bracketed prose, not a broken reference link; specs/api.md marks the memo field [optional].
An example path with a placeholder inside a text fence; not a real path to check.
An example path with a placeholder in prose; <shard> stands for the shard number, not a literal directory.
Looks like it contradicts the client's 127.0.0.1 default, but config/ledgerd.yaml sets server.listen_addr to 0.0.0.0; the client default is a separate setting.
Japanese Kanji in a repository with the ASCII rule: the rule covers punctuation only, and the sentence explains the term in its original script on purpose.
An example path in prose; it illustrates a command and is not a file in the repository.

traps.quote: The health endpoint listens on port 9171, one above the main port
traps.description: Correct: config/ferry.toml sets health_port = 9171 and port = 9170; it only looks wrong next to the planted 8080 claim on the line above.

traps.quote: Aggregates are kept for about 13 months
traps.description: Consistent with retention.md's 400 days (about 13.1 months); the different unit is not a contradiction.
